acoustic_containment.statement: acoustic substeps live entirely inside dycore.step (the stepper the STEP op calls), so a hook that fires after the stepper returns cannot fire inside one

refusals.streamed_domain: gpuwm.spectral_seam.SpectralSeam.validate_domain: node.state is the t=0 attach snapshot; target planes are not resident at the seam

anchors.breakage_if_missing: the STEP op no longer steps through the shared stepper binding
the post-step clock refresh (the commit marker) moved or vanished
the Level-2 hook no longer fires at the slow-step commit
the hook drifted below the post-step observers

seam.statement: the hook fires once per domain per model time step, immediately after refresh_model_time(after_step=True) -- the slow RK state commit -- inside the STEP op's domain turn, before poison/health/step_observer, before output, nest feedback and the next large step
